hook: Anton Osika co-founded Lovable in November 2023 to let people build software by describing it in plain English. He came to it through physics rather than software: an MSc in engineering physics and applied mathematics from KTH, a bachelor's from the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, and a stint at CERN working on ATLAS supersymmetry triggers, the algorithms that decide which events from petabytes of raw detector data are worth keeping. He was the first employee and engineer at Sana Labs, then co-founded and was CTO of Depict.ai. In 2023 he released GPT-Engineer as open source, it reached roughly 50,000 GitHub stars, and the commercial product followed.

Created GPT-Engineer, the open-source code generation project that preceded the company and reached around 50,000 GitHub stars
CTO and co-founder of Depict.ai from 2020 to 2023, a two-time top Y Combinator startup serving billions of product recommendations

achievements.title: GPT-Engineer
